articles.title: Swiss central bank bitcoin reserve push fails over signature shortfall
articles.snippet: The initiative sought to amend Switzerland's constitution, requiring the Swiss National Bank (SNB) to hold BTC alongside gold and foreign-currency reserves.

articles.title: LayerZero says it ‘made a mistake’ in $292 Million Kelp exploit
articles.snippet: After initially framing the exploit as a developer configuration failure, LayerZero said it “owns” the decision to let its own verifier secure high-value transfers in a vulnerable setup.

articles.title: US CLARITY Act sees ‘big step forward’ as markup set for May 14
articles.snippet: Coinbase chief policy officer Faryar Shirzad said the date is a “big step forward” and is essential for supporting innovation in the US.
